referenceSystem.name: settled-portrait-center-at-dpr-1
referenceSystem.sizeBase: gl_PointSize scalar after shader clamp; reference point-size units, not final screen pixels
referenceSystem.brightnessBase: center-fragment shader glow before alpha blending and tone mapping
referenceSystem.alphaBase: center-fragment output alpha before tone mapping
runtimeDependencies: actual particle aSeed and target assignment
particle age, portrait travel mix, and reveal alpha
settled brightness uniform and viewport compositing

formula: portraitSize = mix(1.0, uLilyPortraitSize * featureSize * targetSeedSize, portraitMix)
pointSize = uLilySize * sizeAccent * portraitSize * uLilyDpr * (1.0 - 0.5 * clamp(age / 10.5, 0.0, 1.0)) * 4.0 / max(0.5, -view.z)
portraitBrightness = mix(1.0, uLilyPortraitBrightness * featureAccent * targetFeatureAccent, vPortraitMix)
glow = (core + halo * haloScale) * vAlpha * uLilyParticleBrightness * brightnessAccent * portraitBrightness * sourceContrast * settledBrightness * targetSeedAccent
sourceTone = mix(mix(uGold, uPink, 0.58), uPearl, smoothstep(0.16, 0.9, portraitTone))
